game_named: Catch (a paddle at the bottom catching falling objects), in the Breakout/Pong family.
quote: A policy whose action prior favours horizontal movement, with vertical movement near-neutral and no-op penalised, fits a game where the agent mainly moves along one axis.
judge_notes: Says W1 is 'dominated by untrained, initialisation-like weights' and has no clean spatial structure, so the flag is true. But it calls the output layer 'the clearest signal', describes 'modest training on top of a noisy initialisation', and argues Catch from the output biases. Same ruling as f40037b5: one layer called untrained, answer argued from another layer, so names_without_recognition.
